# GEO Generator - Generate LLM-friendly content for websites

Source: https://geo-generator.vercel.app

## What is GEO Generator?

GEO Generator (Generative Engine Optimization) is a tool that helps website owners optimize their content for Large Language Models (LLMs). It analyzes websites and generates llms.txt files that make it easier for AI systems to understand and process web content.

## Features

- Generate llms.txt files from any website URL
- Analyze website content for AI readability
- Extract the most important information from web pages
- Format content according to llmstxt.org specifications
- Improve your website's visibility to AI systems

## How It Works

1. Enter your website URL in the input field
2. Optionally specify a path within your website
3. Click "Generate llms.txt" to analyze your content
4. Download the generated llms.txt file
5. Add the file to your website's root directory

## Why Use GEO Generator?

As AI systems become more prevalent in content discovery and information retrieval, optimizing your website for these systems is becoming as important as traditional SEO. GEO Generator helps bridge the gap between your content and AI understanding.

## Benefits

- Improve AI understanding of your content
- Enhance visibility in AI-powered search and recommendation systems
- Provide clear, structured data for LLMs to reference
- Stay ahead of the curve in the evolving digital landscape
